content:
The City of Laredo held a public health proclamation ceremony at the Health and Welfare Center on Friday, November 6, bringing together city officials and community members to promote healthy living.

Many in attendance wore navy shirts reading "I Choose to Live Healthy" as Mayor Victor D. Treviño and others spoke at a podium outside the center. A framed proclamation was presented during the ceremony.

Among those taking part were Mayor Treviño, Melissa Cigarroa, Richard Chamberlain and Homero Cantu, according to the city's post.

The event highlighted the city's push for residents to make healthy choices part of everyday life.

Sources: City of Laredo - Government.
